description: Use this when the user wants a way to train for a goal or sport, for example "I want to get more explosive for basketball", "build muscle three days a week" or "train for a half marathon", or wants to train with a named coach, for example "train with Cameron Goodson", and has not picked a programme. Phorme coaching brains are curated training methods: a coach, the principles the method trains by, and a coach-built programme. It returns up to three brains that fit, best first, each with its coach, focus, how it trains and its programmes with weeks and days a week; with a coach named, only that coach's brains. It reads only and changes nothing. Do not use it for injury rehab or nutrition.

coach.description: A coach the user named, for example "Cameron Goodson". Only that coach's brains are returned.

days_per_week.description: Training days a week, only if the user said.

goal.description: What the user wants from training, in their words, for example "jump higher" or "first HYROX race".

sport.description: The sport or position, only if the user named one.

name: find_coaching_brain

brains.description: Best fit first: id, name, coach, coach_title, focus, how_it_trains, image_url and image_alt (Phorme's own picture of the brain, its programme cover or its coach's room: show it, never a web photo), programmes (name, summary, weeks, days_per_week, image_url) and why it fits.

limits.description: What this does not cover. Tell the user.

title: Find a Phorme coaching brain
